players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh returned from a 3-game absence (right side tightness) and went 0-for-3 with 3 K as DH. His BA sits at .174, well below last year's 60-HR MVP-runner-up pace. No IL move expected; Mariners monitoring day-to-day.

sources.title: Mariners' Cal Raleigh back in the lineup
Breaking down Cal Raleigh's 2026 struggles — ESPN

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper went 1-for-4 as the A's routed the Phillies 12-1, snapping Philadelphia's winning streak under Don Mattingly. Despite the loss, Harper is batting .285 with 9 HRs on the year. Andrew Painter was shelled for 8 ER in 3.2 IP.

sources.title: Bryce Harper leads Phillies with two HRs vs Athletics — MLB.com

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez is nursing a sore thumb sustained during a recent road trip. He missed Wednesday's game and the Giants had an off day Thursday. Manager Tony Vitello expects him back for this weekend's Pirates series. He's batting .316 on the year.

sources.title: Luis Arraez out of Giants lineup with thumb injury — MLB.com

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 0-for-3 with a walk in the Mets' 6-2 loss to Colorado, dropping New York to 14-22. He leads the club with 16 RBI but is batting only .215. The Mets continue to struggle as a team.

sources.title: 5/7/2026 Box Score: Rockies 6, Mets 2

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Tigers had an off day Thursday. Kevin McGonigle carries a 6-game hit streak into Friday and is slashing .315/.407/.477 — setting a Tigers franchise record for hits by a LHH in April. He signed an 8-year, $150M extension earlier this spring.

sources.title: Kevin McGonigle first-month review: Historically high marks — Detroit News

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA went 2-for-4 with 2 RBI, including an RBI single in the Cubs' 7-run 4th inning, as Chicago swept Cincinnati 8-3 for its 9th consecutive win and completed a perfect 7-0 homestand at Wrigley. He's slashing .284/.369/.500 over his last 21 games.

sources.title: Enhanced Box Score: Cubs 8, Reds 3 — May 7, 2026 — Bleacher Nation
Cubs recap 5/7/26: Cubs 8, Reds 3 — perfect homestand

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill went 1-for-3 in a 2-1 Padres loss to the Cardinals, with Matthew Liberatore pitching a gem. Masyn Winn's 7th-inning RBI triple was the deciding blow. Merrill had been on a 5-game hitting streak entering the game.

sources.title: Liberatore, Cardinals edge Padres 2-1 — 953thescore.com

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernández is on the 10-day IL with a Grade 1 left adductor strain (placed May 6). He has resumed live batting practice and a rehab assignment with Single-A Rancho Cucamonga is imminent. Possible activation as early as Monday, May 11.

sources.title: Dodgers OF Teoscar Hernandez to IL, will be out for a while — ESPN
Teoscar Hernández set for rehab assignment — MLB.com

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice sat out his 4th consecutive game with a left hand contusion suffered May 3 vs. Baltimore. X-rays were negative and he's day-to-day. Aaron Boone called an IL stint unlikely. Before the injury Rice led MLB with a 1.214 OPS, .343 AVG, and 12 HRs.

sources.title: Yankees' Ben Rice: Remains out Thursday — CBS Sports
Yankees give encouraging news on Ben Rice — HEAVY

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams was not used in Thursday's 6-2 Mets loss to Colorado, getting a rest day after earning his 5th save Wednesday night with a dominant bases-loaded escape in the 10-5 Mets win. He has 5 SV and a 6.00 ERA on the year.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams: Collects fifth save — CBS Sports

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler started May 6 (6.1 IP, 5H, 3ER, 4K, 1BB) in his first home start since Aug 2 after thoracic outlet surgery — the Phillies won 6-3. He holds a 3.11 ERA through 3 starts of his 2026 comeback.

sources.title: Phillies rally behind Zack Wheeler's return — Philadelphia Baseball Review

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans left Wednesday's start vs. Cleveland after 3 shutout innings with left triceps/elbow soreness. Awaiting test results Thursday. The Royals are cautiously optimistic he'll make his next start; Ragans said the sensation was unlike his prior Tommy John issues.

sources.title: Cole Ragans exits with triceps/elbow soreness — MLB.com
Royals hopeful Ragans makes his next start — RotoBaller

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns did not start Thursday. His last outing (May 3 vs. Pittsburgh) was a career-high 7 shutout innings. He leads the NL in pitching WAR with a 2.21 ERA and 46 K in 41.2 IP — on track to reach 100 K faster than any Reds pitcher in history.

sources.title: Chase Burns fires season-high seven innings — RotoWire

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi was dominant Wednesday — 8 IP, 3H, 0 ER, 8 K, 0 BB in a 6-1 Rangers win at Yankee Stadium, his 2nd excellent outing vs. New York in 8 days. He is 5-2 with a 2.22 ERA in his last 11 starts against the Yankees since April 2022.

sources.title: Nathan Eovaldi silences the Yankees for a 2nd time in 8 days — Washington Post

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan did not start Thursday. He is scheduled to start tonight (May 8) at St. Louis. His last start showed velocity concerns — averaging 93.4 mph on his four-seamer — though he still generates elite swing-and-miss on his slider.

sources.title: Emmet Sheehan improving in key area each start — DodgerBlue

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers did not start Thursday. His last start was May 5 vs. the White Sox; next start is scheduled May 10 vs. the Blue Jays. He is 1-2 with a 4.28 ERA through 7 starts and remains in the Angels' rotation all season.

sources.title: Reid Detmers rewarding Angels' faith in rotation — Yardbarker
